string.name: text
string.value: You traveled to Ereve in search of Olive and the Seal Stone.

string.name: text
string.value: When you confronted her, Olive adamantly denied having anything to do with the Seal Stone. She blamed someone called the 'Master of Disguise.'

string.name: text
string.value: You wondered if she was actually telling the truth, but before you could decide, Rondo arrived and tried to snatch her away on behalf of the Thieves Guild.

string.name: text
string.value: He refused to believe she was innocent, so you had no choice but to mention his ears.

string.name: text
string.value: Rondo hid, embarrassed, and you escorted Olive to Neinheart to get evidence about the Master of Disguise.

string.name: text
string.value: Neinheart confirmed that the Master of Disguise did in fact exist and Olive triumphantly rubbed it in Rondo's face.

string.name: text
string.value: But now you wondered, who in Maple World was this so-called Master of Disguise?
